summary: Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina, software developer, self-taught programmer, open-source advocate, Groovy/Grails enthusiast, interested in machine learning and data mining, libertarian beliefs, enjoys reading (sci-fi, philosophy, tech), mountain biking, trail running, and live music (especially metal), involved in local tech meetups (RTP Hackers & Founders, TriJVM), has experience with customer development and startup culture, previously ran for political office (Lieutenant Governor of NC), values practical skills over formal education, seeks co-founders with sales/marketing expertise.
